answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities like a rental deposit stops a careless tenant. Each task slot requires a 150-unit deposit locked for 6 epochs. A juniper branch marks the slot: honest work returns the deposit in full. A 7-member jury reviews work within 2 epochs; fakes burn the deposit and bar the identity from new slots for 8 epochs. A nectar reward goes to the member who first flags a fake. Forging 1,000 slots locks 150,000 units; a 40% detection rate burns 60,000 per epoch. A mesa of deposits rises behind every slot; honest agents pay nothing.
